scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.db:setup: cd backend && npx prisma generate --schema=../database/schema.prisma && npx prisma db push --schema=../database/schema.prisma && npx tsx ../database/seed.ts
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:setup
